source.label: Product board twist decided by recorded killers

reviewer: Claude Code with sole fresh-context medium reviewer

claims.summary: Over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with m pigeons and n holes (multilinear ring or Boolean axioms) at its top degree D=n, Y the hole-respecting assignments, x=x_ab a hole variable, S a set of variables other than x, P = {x_kb: k!=a} union S and 1<=K'<=n-1: F = {f of degree <=K': p f in C for p in P} has a member outside C iff tau<=K', tau the number of distinct holes the variables of P lie in; then, if hole b is touched (b in H, e.g. m>=2), x prod_{j in H minus b}(1-sum_k x_kj), H the touched holes, lies in F minus C, a scalar repair x m with deg m = tau-1. Consequently, at any window W>=2 with room TW+deg nu<=n, a twisted repair with one twisted variable x, weight x and variable errors S (K'=T+deg nu<=n-1) implies, with b in H, a scalar repair with multiplier degree tau-1<=T+deg nu-1 for the same errors, at most deg nu when T=1 (necessary direction, via the pair identity of lem:twist-window-trade).
claims.assessment: Working proof from lem:top-degree-killer-transfer, lem:cylinder-killer-degree and lem:top-degree-axiom-inertness, set out by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer and written and checked step by step in a follow-up (review record in research/results/common_multiplier_product_twist_20261016).
claims.rationale: On the product pigeonhole system at its top degree, single twists with weight a hole variable add nothing beyond scalar repairs; decides check:product-board-twist.
claims.next_action: Twists in two different holes, first x_00 and x_11 on three pigeons and two holes at D'=2.

claims.summary: Exact F_2 computation with tools/pc_closure.py on the product pigeonhole system with 4 pigeons and 3 holes (multilinear ring, pigeon axioms prod_j(1+x_ij), hole axioms) at its top degree D'=3 (closure dim 178 of 299, proper), window D-K=2, K=1, T=1, deg nu=1, tight room, twisted variable and weight x_00: for every nonempty error set S of the other 11 variables (2047 sets), the twisted-pair space F_S = {f in V_2: x_k0 f, E f in C} has a survivor (f not in C) for 247 sets, and each of these 247 has a product survivor r m (r, m linear) and indeed a scalar repair x_00 m of degree 1; no set has a twisted pair without a scalar repair. The count matches cor:top-degree-twist-scalar (tau<=2 iff S avoids touching both holes 1 and 2: 2^7+2^7-2^3-1=247); positive control (synthetic, three condition variables) sees its gap.
claims.assessment: Exact computation, script and counts checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer; it confirms cor:top-degree-twist-scalar's count and validates the script.
claims.rationale: On the one proper top-degree board, twisted (matrix) repairs with one twisted variable add nothing beyond scalar repairs of degree one.
claims.next_action: Prove that on the product pigeonhole system at its top degree a survivor of F_S gives a scalar repair of degree one.
